title: Unblock bc login due to pp failures
summary: Business Central sign-in no longer blocks when Power Platform environment lookup fails. The change handles lookup failures gracefully by logging telemetry for diagnosis while allowing sign-in to proceed.
key_points: Prevents sign-in blocking when linked Power Platform environment lookup fails
Lookup failures are logged to telemetry instead of being surfaced to the caller
Null GUIDs and empty environment responses are ignored
Returns a clear error when no Power Platform tenant is configured
Adds integration tests for failed, null, valid and empty-response scenarios
quote: Prevents Business Central sign-in from being blocked when the linked Power Platform environment lookup fails.
